messages.text: Pipeline is green. Image built, tests passed. Ready to deploy to prod at 2pm. Just need the usual sign-off.
Hold. I don't see a security review on this PR. When was the image last scanned for CVEs?
Scan runs in stage 2. It passed. I can resend the report—everything's automated.
I need to see it. And the Dockerfile: who maintains the base image? Is it from a trusted registry with a digest?
Official node:20-alpine, digest pinned. We've used it for months. No incidents.
No known incidents isn't compliance. Show me the scan output and the dependency audit. Until then, no prod deploy.
I'm not trying to skip steps. I just want to ship. Automation should make this faster, not a bottleneck.
Automation that ships vulnerable code is just faster failure. Once I see the checklist and the scan, I'll sign off. No shortcuts.
Understood. I'll add a mandatory security gate so you get visibility by default. Report will be in the PR from now on.
Good. Then we're aligned. Ping me when the gate is in place and I'll approve this one.
Will do. Thanks for keeping the bar high—even when it slows me down.
